title: RulesetEntityDefinition
description: Schema for an entity definition file inside a ruleset (e.g. rulesets/open5e/entities/character.json), defining entity metadata, property schemas, calculations, and default values.

id.description: Entity type identifier matching the ruleset manifest (e.g. 'character', 'monster', 'spell', 'item').

name.description: Human-readable name of the entity type (e.g. 'Player Character').

description.description: Description of what this entity represents.

ruleset_id.description: Identifier of the ruleset to which this entity type belongs (e.g. 'open5e').

version.description: Version of this entity definition schema.

default_template.description: Identifier of the default template (mode 'sheet'/'view'/'card'/'print') used to display entities of this type.

allowed_templates.description: Template IDs that are compatible with this entity type.

default_editor.description: Identifier of the default template (mode 'edit') used to author/edit entities of this type. Must match a manifest template entry whose 'mode' is 'edit' and whose 'entity_types' includes this entity's id.

schema.description: A JSON Schema describing the structure, types, and constraints of the entity's 'properties' object.

properties.description: Property definitions for this entity type.

calculated_properties.description: Standard calculation rules or formulas for derived entity properties.

expr.description: Expression (math, logical, or string) defining how this property is derived.

type.description: Resulting data type of the calculation.

dependencies.description: Names of properties this calculation depends on.

default_values.description: Initial default values for properties when instantiating a new entity of this type.

ui.description: Optional recursive UI/editor metadata: widget assignments, field groupings, and display hints used by 'edit' mode templates to render this entity's form.

uiFieldDescriptor.description: UI/editor layout and widget assignment for an entity or a single property. Recurses via 'fields' to describe nested object properties.

widget.description: ID of an editor widget template (a manifest template with mode 'widget') that renders this field/entity as a whole, overriding the type-based default (e.g. 'action-list-editor', 'ability-score-stepper').

label.description: Display label override for this field.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text hint for text-like widgets.

hidden.description: Whether to omit this field from generated editor forms.

readonly.description: Whether this field should render as non-editable (e.g. a value derived from 'calculated_properties' or from other fields, like 'level' being derived from 'class_levels').

order.description: Sort order hint relative to sibling fields.

config.description: Arbitrary options passed through to the resolved widget template (e.g. { "maxItems": 20 }).

fields.description: UI descriptors for nested child properties, keyed by property name. Only used when no 'widget' is set (or the widget itself recurses into 'fields').
